sentence: This project tests whether imaging and blood tests taken during treatment can show which patients with oropharyngeal carcinoma can safely get a lower radiation dose.
This project builds research on how climate change affects health in American Indian and rural communities and turns the findings into practical steps.
This project studies how stress activates the immune system, makes the blood brain barrier more permeable and changes brain activity linked to reward.
This project studies which enzymes turn Vitamin A into a gene-controlling molecule and how low levels affect the failing heart.
This project tries to find out which gut bacteria and bacterial pathways are linked to how patients with advanced kidney cancer respond to immunotherapy.
This project studies whether disrupted circadian rhythms cause mood and sleep problems in women during menopause, and whether timed sleep and light treatments help.
This project studies how small cell lung cancer spreads, using models made from human stem cells, patient-derived xenografts and sequencing.
This project tries to find out how cell type-specific mechanisms lead to hypertension and kidney injury.
This project tests whether a gene replacement therapy works and is safe in mice with a mitochondrial disorder.
This project builds a gene therapy tool from a transposase that inserts large DNA pieces at chosen sites in human cells.
This project tries to find out how a viral protein holds back the replication of cytomegalovirus.
This project studies how a molecule that rises in blood after intense exercise reduces food intake and body weight in obese mice.
This project studies how a receptor in the tumor environment blocks immune attack on hepatocellular carcinoma, and tests antibodies that block it.
This project studies how stem cells make intermediate progenitors and how this is controlled to support normal brain development and prevent brain tumors.
This project studies how human T follicular helper cells develop and mature to help B cells make antibodies after an mRNA vaccine.
This project builds a fast, sensitive test that measures antibody binding to a virus protein, as a quicker stand-in for neutralization assays.
This project tests how ongoing stress, reactions to sudden stress and thoughts about cannabis add to cannabis use and related problems.
This project studies how a family of proteins called tubulin polymerization promoting proteins affects mitochondria and nerve cell survival in Parkinson's disease.
This project studies where neural stem cells in the adult hippocampus come from and what they do, using animal and human models.
This project teaches genetics and genomics knowledge and experimental tools that help answer questions between genetics and medicine.
